text:
sara: customer-prod-42 reported sustained 504s and timeouts for hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate starting ~11:02 UTC. They say retries didn't help and errors cluster during bursts. escalating to incidents.
raj: looking. any quick repro link or customer request id?
sara: sent sample request id 8a7f... and p95 latency >20s before 504s. customer on dedicated plan.
emily: vm/gateway logs show 'upstream request timeout' and lots of 'no ready pods' in router logs. forwarding snippets.
mike_oncall: opsbot, show current pods for tenant-prod-42 deployment (scale group rg-inference-42).
opsbot: kubectl get pods -l tenant=prod-42 --namespace=redwood-inference
opsbot: NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
ops-infer-42-0                    0/1     Init:0/1   0          3m
ops-infer-42-1                    1/1     Running    0          25m
ops-infer-42-2                    0/1     Init:0/1   0          2m
sara: two pods stuck initializing -> explains capacity gap during spike. any init logs?
priyanka: checking model fetch logs and init hooks; could be model download slow (coldstart) + readiness probe misconfigured.
raj: I see KEDA ScaledObject targets queueLength. But scaledobject's cooldown is 300s and pollingInterval 30s. tenant traffic spiky -> scaleup lag. also liveness/readiness probe has initialDelaySeconds=120 which delays readiness even after pod up.
emily: combine that with model pull from S3 (large quant weights) -> init time ~90s. KEDA polling 30s + cooldown 300s means slow reaction.
mike_oncall: customer reports burst from 11:00-11:04; we had only 1 ready pod during that time. scaling attempt kicked off but pods stuck in init for ~2m each. gateway returned 504s.
sara: customer unhappy, opening support ticket INC-2026-742. cc @support-bot for credits.
support-bot: Support ticket INC-2026-742 created. Provisional credit offer drafted.
priyanka: quick mitigation: manually scale deployment to minReplicas=3 for that tenant to cover warmup window. can do rolling update to avoid repeated init.
raj: I'm going to patch ScaledObject pollingInterval -> 10s and cooldown -> 60s for tenant-prod-42 as emergency. that's risky org-wide but isolate to namespace.
emily: recommend also lowering readiness initialDelaySeconds to 10 and add postStart hook that warms minimal model (fast path) to reduce init. but that requires image change. not safe for immediate.
mike_oncall: doing manual scale now: kubectl scale deployment ops-infer-42 --replicas=3 --namespace=redwood-inference
opsbot: deployment.apps/ops-infer-42 scaled to 3
opsbot: new pods starting, one still Init:0/1, one Running. routing backlog draining.
priyanka: adding a temporary annotation to scaledobject to reduce polling for this tenant:
priyanka: ```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: so-tenant-prod-42
  namespace: redwood-inference
  annotations:
    keda.scaledobject.pollingInterval: "10"
    keda.scaledobject.cooldownPeriod: "60"
```
raj: applied patch. will monitor.
emily: gateway errors dropping, p95 down to 600ms after scale. customer confirms traffic normalized.
sara: customer update sent: "we deployed temporary scaling changes and are investigating root cause; will follow up with permanent fix and credits" :thumbsup:
support-bot: Customer notified via ticket INC-2026-742.
mike_oncall: follow-ups: 1) Evaluate making pollInterval shorter for bursty tenants by tag 2) Add metrics alarm for 'no ready pods while queue>threshold' 3) Consider pre-warm job for large-model tenants 4) Review readiness probe and postStart warm path 5) Run postmortem and link to runbook.
raj: logging action items in ops-triage board — card #OT-884.
priyanka: quick repro steps for engineers:
priyanka: 1) set test tenant scaledobject pollInterval=30 and cooldown=300, deploy large model 2) generate burst load (locust script attached) 3) observe no-ready-pods windows and gateway 504s 4) capture init logs and model fetch durations
priyanka: attach locust link: https://internal-load-tests/redwood/locust/tenant-warmup-burst
sara: adding customer follow-up timeline to ticket and scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
emily: note: also saw a handful of imagePullBackOff earlier for a different tenant — separate incident but could exacerbate coldstart risk.
mike_oncall: for immediate customer relief we left manual replica increase and the scaledobject patch; plan is to revert after we roll a readiness-optimized image or implement pre-warm.
raj: closing loop here; will update when postmortem is done. great triage everyone. :heart:
